versions.content: Execution Management shall support the binding of all threads of a given process to a specified set of processor cores. Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: RS_SAF_10008 Description: Execution Management shall allow the binding of threads to specific set of processor cores based on configuration in the Execution Manifest . The binding granularity shall be at process level. Rationale: Mechanism to influence load balancing, reaction times, and latencies. Dependencies: – Use Case: A Process can be assigned to designated cores to limit thread migration between cores available on the Machine . Supporting Material: –
